=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18890 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: EXHAUSTED_FIXUP_IDS_JSON projects raw `.id` preserving the JSON type (string or number), but the issue_number_map lookup at line 18892 via `$ids[] as $id | (.issue_number_map[$id] // empty)` uses the raw id value as a jq key. The creation loop at 5218 stores ids as strings via shell `jq --arg fix_id` (all shell variables are strings). If the judge emits a numeric id like `{"id": 42, "title": "Fix race"}`, the creation loop stores `issue_number_map["42"]` (string key) but the exhausted-arm lookup at 18892 queries `issue_number_map[42]` (number key). In jq, string and number keys are distinct.
  WHY: A numeric id that passes the filter at 18890 silently fails the string-keyed issue_number_map lookup at 18892. The exhausted arm then reports "Fix-up issues filed from this verdict: none" when the creation loop actually filed the fix-up. The operator sees a false negative in the Project Failed comment, completion-status comment, and CRITICAL Telegram alert.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18892 (EXHAUSTED_FIXUP_REFS lookup), 5182-5187 (creation-loop dedup guard) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When the creation loop's dedup guard finds a prior open issue and skips creation (lines 5182-5187), it still re-attaches the existing issue_number_map entry to the wave. The exhausted-arm refs query at 18892 then resolves that id to the pre-existing issue number. The message text says "Fix-up issues filed from this verdict" but the reported issue was filed in an earlier cycle, not from the current verdict.
  WHY: The Project Failed comment and Telegram alert tell the operator "Fix-up issues filed from this verdict: #100" when #100 was created in cycle 1, not from the exhausted verdict. The linked issue IS the correct one to track on /judge_resume, so the behavior is correct — only the messaging is wrong.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18878-18920 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The documented contract in the changelog contributor note says "each failed verdict logs a RECOVERY_BUDGET_ACCOUNTING line." The in-budget arm at line 18940 emits one, but the exhausted arm (lines 18878-18920) does not. The exhausted verdict is still a failed verdict — it should be logged so the workflow-log-analysis pipeline can count it.
  WHY: The workflow-log-analysis pipeline, which depends on RECOVERY_BUDGET_ACCOUNTING lines for operational metrics, silently misses exhausted verdicts. This makes the project-convergence reporting incomplete — operators cannot see in logs how many distinct-vs-repeat findings preceded exhaustion.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5160 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The echo banner "Creating ${NEW_ISSUES_COUNT} fix-up issue(s)..." at line 5160 uses NEW_ISSUES_COUNT, which counts all array entries including those that the malformed-entry guard at line 5171 will skip. The logged count overstates the number of issues actually created.
  WHY: The Telegram WARNING at line 19002 also uses NEW_ISSUES_COUNT. An operator seeing "Orchestrator auto-recovery ... started for #N: 3 fix-up issues, 0 reverts" when only 1 was created would investigate the wrong number of issues. This is a simple banner mismatch between the pre-echo count and the post-guard reality.
- README.md:lines 171 and 1871 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The README says the backpressure margin absorbs "judge conflict-merges" (line 171: "judge-added fix-up squashes and judge conflict-merges"; line 1871: "absorbs judge conflict-merges and judge-added fix-up issues"). But the code at `_integration_branch_ahead_of_default` defines work-commits as commits with fewer than 2 parents (line 3782: `select(((.parents // []) | length) < 2)`). Judge conflict-merges are 2-parent merge commits and are always excluded from the count — the margin never absorbs them.
  WHY: Operators reading the docs may over-provision the margin, thinking it needs to cover merge volume that the code never counts. Since the code is correct (excluding sync-merges fixed the self-deadlock), the margin is the defect.
- agents.md:lines 571-572 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The last commit (7f0636f) registers RECOVERY_BUDGET_ACCOUNTING in agents.md's stable log prefix list but does not update the BACKPRESSURE_TRIGGERED / BACKPRESSURE_CLEARED prefix documentation to reflect the new raw_ahead_by= and work_ahead_by= keys. The stable prefix list is contractual, and workflow-log-analysis depends on the documented fields.
  WHY: No runtime failure — the prefixes are contractual markers and the new keys are additive. The concern is documentation drift: future log-analysis code that reads the contractual doc may miss the new keys.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18890 | severity=undefined | confidence=undefined
  PROBLEM: EXHAUSTED_FIXUP_IDS_JSON projects raw .id but issue_number_map is keyed by string ids
  WHY: Suggested minimal fix: change the projection to `| (.id | tostring)]` so the refs lookup uses the same string form the creation loop records
